{{Quote|What do you know about cloning?''"<br />"''Enough to know that it's a dangerous enterprise. So what is it? Someone's reported that we're running a cloning facility and you're here to investigate?''"<br />"''Something like that.|[[Lunis]] and [[Stiv Kram]]|<ref name="RDV" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lunis]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obs Kaj]] went on a '''mission''' to [[Katanos VII]] in order to investigate alleged [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] activities taking place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
